name: watch
usage:
watch for changes to input and live reload. Use $HOST and $PORT to specify the listening address.
(default localhost:0, which will open on a randomly available local port).

name: host
usage: host listening address when used with watch

name: port
usage: port listening address when used with watch

name: bundle
usage: when outputting SVG, bundle all assets and layers into the output file

name: allow-private-network
usage: allow remote image assets to access private, loopback, and link-local networks. Only enable this for trusted diagrams. Can also be set with $D2_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK

name: force-appendix
usage: an appendix for tooltips and links is added to PNG exports since they are not interactive. --force-appendix adds an appendix to SVG exports as well

name: debug
usage: print debug logs.

name: img-cache
usage: in watch mode, images used in icons are cached for subsequent compilations. This should be disabled if images might change.

name: layout
usage: the layout engine used

name: theme
usage: the diagram theme ID

name: dark-theme
usage: the theme to use when the viewer's browser is in dark mode. When left unset -theme is used for both light and dark mode. Be aware that explicit styles set in D2 code will still be applied and this may produce unexpected results. We plan on resolving this by making style maps in D2 light/dark mode specific. See https://github.com/d2lang/d2/issues/831.

name: pad
usage: pixels padded around the rendered diagram

name: animate-interval
usage: if given, multiple boards are packaged as 1 SVG which transitions through each board at the interval (in milliseconds). Can only be used with SVG or GIF exports. For GIF exports, defaults to 1000ms if not specified.

name: timeout
usage: the maximum number of seconds that D2 runs for before timing out and exiting. When rendering a large diagram, it is recommended to increase this value

name: version
usage: get the version

name: sketch
usage: render the diagram to look like it was sketched by hand

name: isometric
usage: render SVG, PNG, GIF, PDF or PPTX in isometric perspective, preserving the compiled layout; also configurable through vars.d2-config.isometric

name: stdout-format
usage: output format when writing to stdout (svg, png, ascii, txt, pdf, pptx, gif). Usage: d2 input.d2 --stdout-format svg - > output.svg

name: browser
usage: browser executable that watch opens. Setting to 0 opens no browser.

name: center
usage: center the SVG in the containing viewbox, such as your browser screen

name: scale
usage: scale the output. E.g., 0.5 to halve the default size. Default -1 means that SVG's will fit to screen and all others will use their default render size. Setting to 1 turns off SVG fitting to screen.

name: target
usage: target board to render. Pass an empty string to target root board. If target ends with '*', it will be rendered with all of its scenarios, steps, and layers. Otherwise, only the target board will be rendered. E.g. --target='' to render root board only or --target='layers.x.*' to render layer 'x' with all of its children.

name: font-regular
usage: path to .ttf file to use for the regular font. If none provided, Source Sans Pro Regular is used.

name: font-italic
usage: path to .ttf file to use for the italic font. If none provided, Source Sans Pro Regular-Italic is used.

name: font-bold
usage: path to .ttf file to use for the bold font. If none provided, Source Sans Pro Bold is used.

name: font-semibold
usage: path to .ttf file to use for the semibold font. If none provided, Source Sans Pro Semibold is used.

name: font-mono
usage: path to .ttf file to use for the monospace font. If none provided, Source Code Pro Regular is used.

name: font-mono-bold
usage: path to .ttf file to use for the monospace bold font. If none provided, Source Code Pro Bold is used.

name: font-mono-italic
usage: path to .ttf file to use for the monospace italic font. If none provided, Source Code Pro Italic is used.

name: font-mono-semibold
usage: path to .ttf file to use for the monospace semibold font. If none provided, Source Code Pro Semibold is used.

name: check
usage: check that the specified files are formatted correctly.

name: no-xml-tag
usage: omit XML tag (<?xml ...?>) from output SVG files. Useful when generating SVGs for direct HTML embedding

name: salt
usage: Add a salt value to ensure the output uses unique IDs. This is useful when generating multiple identical diagrams to be included in the same HTML doc, so that duplicate IDs do not cause invalid HTML. The salt value is a string that will be appended to IDs in the output.

name: omit-version
usage: omit D2 version from generated image

name: ascii-mode
usage: ASCII rendering mode for text outputs. Options: 'standard' (basic ASCII chars) or 'extended' (Unicode chars)

name: dagre-nodesep
usage: number of pixels that separate nodes horizontally.

name: dagre-edgesep
usage: number of pixels that separate edges horizontally.

name: elk-algorithm
usage: layout algorithm

name: elk-nodeNodeBetweenLayers
usage: the spacing to be preserved between any pair of nodes of two adjacent layers

name: elk-padding
usage: the padding to be left to a parent element’s border when placing child elements

name: elk-edgeNodeBetweenLayers
usage: the spacing to be preserved between nodes and edges that are routed next to the node’s layer

name: elk-edgeEdgeBetweenLayers
usage: the spacing to be preserved between pairs of edges routed between the same pair of layers

name: elk-nodeSelfLoop
usage: spacing to be preserved between a node and its self loops

name: tala-seeds
usage: random seeds for deterministic TALA layout attempts; the best complete result is selected.
